en: Colorized panoramic view of a European city set in a valley with surrounding hills and mountains. In the foreground is a calm body of water with several small rowboats carrying people. Along the shore stands an ornate lakeside building with towers and a red roof, with tree-lined paths and other villas behind it. The middle and background show dense urban buildings, churches, and greenery rising up towards a hill with a fortification on top. Printed red text at the top reads in German.
